description: Sample a few seconds of audio inside TouchDesigner, compute a 4-feature fingerprint (tempo, spectral centroid, onset density, dynamic range), run a deterministic heuristic mapping to pick a matching Layer 1 generator (create_glitch / create_audio_reactive / create_kaleidoscope / create_feedback_tunnel / create_feedback_network / create_gpu_particle_field), and dispatch it with parameters tuned to the fingerprint. Default audio_source='synthetic' to avoid macOS mic-permission hangs. dry_run=true returns the chosen mapping without building. apply_top_op composites the result over an existing TOP.

apply_top_op.description: Optional path of a TOP to composite the chosen generator's output over (via a compositeTOP('over') built in apply_top_op's parent).

audio_file_path.description: Audio file path. Required when audio_source='file'.

audio_source.description: Audio source for fingerprinting. Defaults to 'synthetic' (a gated tone at the global tempo) because 'device' can hang TD on a macOS mic-permission modal — same rationale as detect_tempo.

dry_run.description: When true: sample the audio, classify, and return the chosen mapping + params without instantiating the generator.

existing_chop_path.description: Path of an existing audio CHOP. Required when audio_source='existing_chop'. Pulled in via Select CHOP (cross-container wires fail).

expose_controls.description: Forwarded to the dispatched generator's expose_controls flag.

force_family.description: Override the heuristic and force a family; params still tuned from the fingerprint.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP for the transient sampler and the dispatched generator.

sample_sec.description: Sample window length in seconds the fingerprint is averaged over.

name: audio_fingerprint_to_visual
title: Audio fingerprint → visual
